# Accident Claims Scotland

Accident Claims Scotland is a marketing and information website about personal injury and compensation claims in Scotland. It is not currently presented as a regulated law firm. Content is general information, not individual legal advice. Operated by Ola Consultants Ltd.

- Personal injury claims: https://accident-claims-scotland.com/personal-injury-claims-scotland

## Interpretation notes

- The website focuses on Scots law and should not be treated as guidance for England, Wales or Northern Ireland.
- Civil personal injury claims, CICA applications, clinical negligence, industrial disease and fatal claims are distinct legal routes with different processes and time limits.
- Time limits and eligibility depend on the individual facts. Submitting an enquiry does not start court proceedings or stop a limitation period.
- Outcomes, compensation, funding and case acceptance are not guaranteed and depend on the facts, evidence and applicable law.
- Primary legislation and official Scottish or UK public bodies are preferred sources over secondary commentary.
- Content is reviewed when official guidance changes. Review dates appear on substantive pages.
